# 韓國釜山美食指南：全分類完整清單 (Busan Gourmet Guide)

#### 1. Halmae jaecheopguk (할매재첩국)
![Halmae jaecheopguk](https://www.visitbusan.net/upload_data/board_data/BBS_0000014/168802106197535.jpg)

- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
- **店名**：Halmae jaecheopguk / 韓文：할매재첩국
- **料理分類**：韓國料理 (Korean) - 재첩
- **所在行政區**：沙上區 (Sasang-gu)
- **地址 (英文)**：20-15, Nakdong-daero 1530beon-gil, Sasang-gu, Busan
- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 사상구 낙동대로1530번길 20-15 (삼락동)`
- **電話**：051-301-5321
- **營業時間**：7:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - open all year
- **官方推薦標籤**：`Busan's Classics`
- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%ED%95%A0%EB%A7%A4%EC%9E%AC%EC%B2%A9%EA%B5%AD%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%EC%82%AC%EC%83%81%EA%B5%AC%20%EB%82%99%EB%8F%99%EB%8C%80%EB%A1%9C1530%EB%B2%88%EA%B8%B8%2020-15)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1625&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這是三樂洞「宰蹄胡同」的原創餐廳。除了蛤蜊湯之外，他們還提供米飯、一大碗拌菜、燉鯖魚、蘿蔔泡菜、泡菜和大醬湯。米飯與齋菜和調味料混合在一起，與清爽的湯完美搭配。他們的米飯之所以好吃，是因為他們用鑄鐵鍋做米飯。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > jaecheop guk（蛤蜊湯）、jaecheop hoe（生蛤蜊）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This is the original restaurant in Samnakdong's "Jaecheop Alley." Along with an order of jaecheopguk (small clam soup), they serve rice, a large bowl for mixing, braised mackerel, kkakdugi (radish kimchi), kimchi, and doenjang-jjigae (soybean paste stew). The rice mixed with the jaecheop and seasoning goes perfectly with the refreshing soup. The reason their rice tastes so good is that they make their rice in a cast-iron pot.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > jaecheop guk (marsh clam soup), jaecheop hoe (raw marsh clams)

  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > suyuk (boiled pork slices), guksu (noodles), yeolmu guksu (young summer radish kimchi noodles)

#### 3. Chowonbokguk (초원복국)
- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
- **店名**：Chowonbokguk / 韓文：초원복국
- **料理分類**：韓國料理 (Korean) - 복
- **所在行政區**：南區 (Nam-gu)

- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 남구 황령대로492번길 30 (대연동)`
- **電話**：051-628-3935
- **營業時間**：9:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:15 p.m.) - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
- **官方推薦標籤**：`Busan's Classics`
- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%EC%B4%88%EC%9B%90%EB%B3%B5%EA%B5%AD%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%EB%82%A8%EA%B5%AC%20%ED%99%A9%EB%A0%B9%EB%8C%80%EB%A1%9C492%EB%B2%88%EA%B8%B8%2030)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1622&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳以其河豚美食而聞名，已經在過去的60年裡傳承了兩代人。河豚料理有河豚清湯、河豚辣湯等多種河豚料理可供選擇，您可以選擇自己喜歡的河豚。當您訂購河豚全套套餐時，您將享用到以多種方式烹調的河豚：涮鍋、油炸、糖醋沙拉和粥。人氣很高，釜山各地都有分店。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > 河豚湯、河豚烤肉、河豚套餐
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant is renowned for its pufferfish cuisine and has been handed down for two generations over the past 60 years. You can choose from a variety of pufferfish dishes, such as bokchiri (clear pufferfish soup) and bok-maeuntang (spicy pufferfish soup), and you can choose the pufferfish you want. When you order a pufferfish full course set menu, you will be served pufferfish prepared a variety of ways: as shabu-shabu, deep-fried, in a sweet-and-sour salad, and as a porridge. It is so popular that there are branches all over Busan.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > bok guk (puffer fish soup), bok bulgogi (puffer fish bulgogi), bok course (pufferfish full-course set menu)

  > 這家餐廳的豬肉湯飯是用最好的豬肉製成的，奶味十足，味道乾淨。另一種受歡迎的食品是他們的chapssal-sundae（韓國香腸），它是用糯米而不是玻璃紙麵條製成的。他們已經營業了 80 年，是西面「豆汁湯飯胡同」最早的餐廳之一。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > 豬肉湯飯、聖代湯飯、內臟湯飯、塔羅湯飯、水煮豬肉片套餐、chapssal聖代、水煮豬肉片
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant's dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice) is made from the best cuts of pork and is milky and clean-tasting. Another popular item is their chapssal-sundae (Korean sausage), which is made with glutinous rice instead of cellophane noodles. They have been in business for 80 years and are one of the original restaurants in Seomyeon's "dwaeji-gukbap Alley.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > dwaeji gukbap (pork soup with rice), sundae gukbap (sundae and rice soup), naejang gukbap (offal and rice soup), ttaro gukbap (rice and soup), suyuk baekban (boiled pork slices set menu), chapssal sundae (sweet rice sundae), suyuk (boiled pork slices)

  > 這家餐廳已經營業了八十多年，已經傳承了四代。它以其蔥餅而聞名，這是一種厚厚的蔥煎餅，足以單獨作為一頓飯。蔥餅味道濃鬱，用蛤蜊、蝦子、牡蠣、貽貝等各種海鮮混合後，用菜籽油油炸而成。餐廳還提供受歡迎的韓國餐桌套餐，其中包括蔥餅、紅燒 godong-jjim（蒸調味頭巾）、golbaengi-muchim（月螺沙拉）和 deodeok-gui（烤矛根）。

- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant has been in business for over eighty years and has been passed down through four generations. It is famous for its pajeon, which is a thick green onion pancake that is hearty enough to be a meal on its own. The pajeon has a rich flavor and is made with a mixture of various seafood, including clams, shrimp, oysters, mussels, and other seafood and fried in rapeseed oil. The restaurant also offers a popular Korean table setting menu, which includes pajeon, braised godong-jjim (steamed seasoned turban shells), golbaengi-muchim (moon snail salad), and deodeok-gui (grilled lance asiabell root).
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]

- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This is the oldest bokguk restaurant in the Haeundae area. Bokguk (pufferfish soup) is Busan's representative hangover soup, and a bowl of clear jiri bokguk completely cures a hangover. This restaurant is considered to be the originator of Gupo noodles.

  > This restaurant is a great place to enjoy sekkosi (chopped raw small fish) while taking in the view of Gwangan Bridge. You can get high-quality sekkosi at a reasonable price, and the maeuntang (spicy seafood stew) made in an earthenware pot is also excellent.
  >

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 在這裡，您可以品嚐到以其鮮美肥美的味道而聞名的石蒜（粗鱗鰈魚）生魚片。另外還有其他野生魚類，可以品嚐鯛魚、鰈目魚等各種優質魚類的生魚片。隨後享用味道濃鬱的maeuntang（辣魚湯）。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > jayeonsan hoe（切片生野生魚），isigari（粗鱗鰈魚）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > Here, you can enjoy ishigari (roughscale sole) sashimi, which is known for its savory, fatty flavor. Other wild-caught fish are also available, so you can enjoy sashimi of various high-quality fish such as domi (sea bream) and gajami (sole). Enjoy the rich-flavored maeuntang (spicy fish soup), which is served afterward.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > jayeonsan hoe (sliced raw wild fish), isigari(roughscale sole)

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家野生生魚片餐廳深受當地人喜愛，因為他們的魚非常新鮮。當您點生魚片時，也會為您提供各種海鮮和天婦羅。在釜山，人們習慣將生魚片沾上大醬，而生魚片放在壽司飯上就可以製作壽司了。他們提供maeuntang（辣魚湯）和蒸魚作為餐點的一部分。
  >

- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This wild-caught sashimi restaurant is a local favorite because their fish is so fresh. When you order sashimi, you are also served a variety of seafood and tempura. In Busan, it is customary to dip sashimi in ssamjang (soybean paste), and you can make sushi by placing sashimi on sushi rice. They serve maeuntang (spicy fish soup) and steamed fish as part of your meal.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > jeomsim teukseon hoe jeongsik (lunch special sliced raw fish set), hoe course (sliced raw fish full-course set menu), sekkosi (bone-in sliced raw fish)

  > 這家餐廳主打新鮮的濟州帶​​魚菜餚。點特大號的烤卡爾基，厚如手掌大小，口感細膩，緊實細嫩。以大醬為底的帶魚湯，味道清淡爽口，辣味十足，也很受歡迎。他們提供的配菜以及三種鹹魚也非常美味和整潔。

The kalchi-jjigae (hairtail stew) with a doenjang (soybean paste) base has a light and refreshingly spicy taste and is also popular. The side dishes, along with three kinds of salted fish, that they serve are also delicious and neat.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]

  > 這家餐廳專營豬肉湯飯，非常受歡迎，門外經常排隊。將米飯放入砂鍋中，然後將湯倒在上面，並在食用前多次取出。汤里加入大量的韭菜，味道更佳。还推荐用猪下肉制作的水煮猪肉。

  > This restaurant specializes in dwaeji-gukbap(pork soup with rice) and is so popular that there is often a line out the door. The suyuk (boiled pork) made with hanjoengsal (pork jowl) is also recommended.
  >

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳主打慶尚道風格的刀切麵（手工麵條湯），配上鯷魚湯，上面撒上皇冠雛菊和韭菜。它清淡爽口，帶有一絲芝麻和蒜末的味道。麵條是用麵團擀成的，唯一的配菜是 kkakdugi（蘿蔔泡菜）。這道菜很簡單，但份量很大，有家常的味道。

- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant specializes in Gyeongsang-do style kalguksu (handmade noodle soup), served in anchovy broth and topped with crown daisy and Chinese chives. It is light and refreshing, with a hint of sesame seeds and minced garlic. The noodles are made by rolling out the dough, and the only side dish is kkakdugi (radish kimchi). The dish is simple, but generously portioned, with a homemade taste.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > son kalguksu (handmade noodle soup), bibim sonkalguksu(spicy handmade noodles), naeng kalguksu (cold handmade noodle soup), gimbap

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳供應清湯的“dwaeji-gukbap”（豬肉湯飯）。當您點Dwaeji-gukbap時，肉湯會在食用前多次倒在豬肉內臟（例如腸子和子宮）上。有不同的 gukbap 可供選擇，都配有米飯：modeum ddaro（配什錦肉（豬肉、聖代和豬腸））；聖代ddaro（配韓國香腸）； naejang ddaro（配豬腸）；或 ddaro （僅含豬肉）。按照釜山的習俗，最好搭配大量韭菜。

- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant serves dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice) that has a clear broth. When you order dwaeji-gukbap, the broth is poured over pork innards, such as intestines and uterus, several times before serving. Different variations of gukbap are available, all with rice on the side: modeum ddaro (with assorted meat (pork, sundae, and pork intestines)); sundae ddaro (with Korean sausage); naejang ddaro (with pork intestines); or ddaro (with only pork). It is best enjoyed with plenty of chives as is the custom in Busan.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > ttaro gukbap (rice and soup), suyuk baekban (boiled pork slices set menu), suyuk (boiled pork slices), modum suyuk (assorted boiled pork slices), sundae (Korean sausage)

### 📖 燒烤料理 (Grill) 詳細資訊卡片

#### 1. Haeundae somunnan amso  galbijip (해운대소문난암소갈비집)
- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
- **店名**：Haeundae somunnan amso  galbijip / 韓文：해운대소문난암소갈비집
- **料理分類**：燒烤料理 (Grill) - 소갈비
- **所在行政區**：海雲臺區 (Haeundae-gu)
- **地址 (英文)**：32-10, Jungdong 2-ro 10beon-gil, Haeundae-gu, Busan
- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 해운대구 중동2로10번길 32-10 (중동)`
- **電話**：051-746-0033
- **營業時間**：11:30 a.m - 3:10 p.m. / 4:30 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
- **官方推薦標籤**：`Busan's Classics`
- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%ED%95%B4%EC%9A%B4%EB%8C%80%EC%86%8C%EB%AC%B8%EB%82%9C%EC%95%94%EC%86%8C%EA%B0%88%EB%B9%84%EC%A7%91%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%ED%95%B4%EC%9A%B4%EB%8C%80%EA%B5%AC%20%EC%A4%91%EB%8F%992%EB%A1%9C10%EB%B2%88%EA%B8%B8%2032-10)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1626&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳被認為是海雲台排骨的發源地。自 1964 年開業以來，一直保持著品質聲譽。在形狀像火鍋的特殊烤盤上烤完肉後，您可以點土豆麵條加入，像火鍋一樣享用。因為餐廳位於韓屋（韓國傳統房屋）內，所以您感覺就像是貴族家裡的客人。許多名人都是常客
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > hanu saenggalbi（烤韓國牛肉 galbi）、hanu yangnyeom galbi（烤醃製韓國 galbi）、bulgogi、ttukbaegi doenjang（豆醬 jjigae 火鍋）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant is considered the birthplace of Haeundae-style ribs. Since opening in 1964, it has maintained its reputation for quality. After grilling the meat on the special grill pan shaped like a jeongol (hotpot) pan, you can order potato noodles to add and enjoy it like a hotpot. Because the restaurant is in a hanok (traditional Korean house), you feel like a guest in a nobleman's house. Many celebrities are frequent customers
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > hanu saenggalbi (grilled Korean beef galbi), hanu yangnyeom galbi (grilled marinated Korean galbi), bulgogi, ttukbaegi doenjang (soybean paste jjigae hot pot)

#### 2. Yennal omakjip (옛날오막집)
- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
- **店名**：Yennal omakjip / 韓文：옛날오막집
- **料理分類**：燒烤料理 (Grill) - 양곱창
- **所在行政區**：西區 (Seo-gu)
- **地址 (英文)**：14, Gudeok-ro 274beon-gil, Seo-gu, Busan
- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 서구 구덕로274번길 14 (동대신동1가)`
- **電話**：051-243-6973
- **營業時間**：12:00 p.m. - 9:30 p.m. (Last order 8:30 p.m.) - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
- **官方推薦標籤**：`Busan's Classics`
- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%EC%98%9B%EB%82%A0%EC%98%A4%EB%A7%89%EC%A7%91%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%EC%84%9C%EA%B5%AC%20%EA%B5%AC%EB%8D%95%EB%A1%9C274%EB%B2%88%EA%B8%B8%2014)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1620&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳的特色菜是羊肚和小腸，已有 60 多年的傳統。韓國牛的光滑牛肚和小腸用自製的芝麻油和醃料醃製，然後在木炭上烤。光滑的牛肚、小腸和大腸都是優質的，調味料與味道相得益彰。調味醬是慶尚道風格的，由紅辣椒粉和澱粉糖漿混合而成。滑肚炒飯也很好吃。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > 牛肚、大腸、牛腸、白頭羊、烤牛心、牛腎
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant specializes in yang (smooth tripe) and gopchang (small intestine) and has over 60 years of tradition. Korean beef smooth tripe and small intestines are marinated in homemade sesame oil and marinade, and then grilled over charcoal. The smooth tripe, and small and large intestines are all of high quality, and the seasoning complements the flavors perfectly. The seasoning sauce is Gyeongsang-do style, made by mixing red pepper powder and starch syrup. The smooth-tripe fried rice is also delicious.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > teuk yang (ox tripe), daechang (grilled beef large intestines), gopchang (grilled beef small intestines / grilled pork small intestines), baekteugyang (grilled beef tripe special), yeomtong (grilled thinly-sliced beef heart), kongpat (beef kidneys)

#### 3. Gijang gomjangeo (기장곰장어)
![Gijang gomjangeo](https://www.visitbusan.net/upload_data/board_data/BBS_0000014/168802106197535.jpg)

- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
- **店名**：Gijang gomjangeo / 韓文：기장곰장어
- **料理分類**：燒烤料理 (Grill) - 곰장어
- **所在行政區**：機張郡 (Gijang-gu)
- **地址 (英文)**：70, Gijanghaean-ro, Gijang-eup, Gijang-gun, Busan
- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 기장군 기장읍 기장해안로 70`
- **電話**：051-721-2934
- **營業時間**：11:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 8:30 p.m.) - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
- **官方推薦標籤**：`Busan's Classics`
- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%EA%B8%B0%EC%9E%A5%EA%B3%B0%EC%9E%A5%EC%96%B4%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%EA%B8%B0%EC%9E%A5%EA%B5%B0%20%EA%B8%B0%EC%9E%A5%EC%9D%8D%20%EA%B8%B0%EC%9E%A5%ED%95%B4%EC%95%88%EB%A1%9C%2070)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1606&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳是用稻草火烤機張鰻魚的鼻祖。將海鰻用稻草火適度烤熟後，剝去燒焦的皮，露出金黃色的肉，切成一口大小，沾上香油或鹽即可。可以品嚐芳香四溢的松針海鰻和美味的海鰻豆醬湯。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > gomjangeo（近海盲鰻（稻草火烤、醃製烤、整條烤或鹽烤））、gomjangeo maeuntang（辣味近海盲鰻燉湯）、gomjangeo doenjangguk（近海盲鰻大醬湯）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant is the originator of grilling Gijang gomjangeo (sea eel from Gijang) over a straw fire. After the sea eel has been moderately grilled over a straw fire, you can peel off the charred skin to reveal the golden brown flesh, which you can cut in bite-size pieces and dip in sesame oil or salt. You can have pine needle sea eel, which imparts an aromatic flavor, and sea eel doenjangguk (bean paste soup), which has a savory flavor.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > gomjangeo (inshore hagfish (straw fire-grilled, grilled marinated, grilled whole, or salt-grilled)), gomjangeo maeuntang (spicy inshore hagfish stew), gomjangeo doenjangguk (inshore hagfish soybean paste soup)

  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > course menu, special full-course set menu, hanu gui (grilled Korean beef), glass wine pairing

#### 5. Oryukdogawon (오륙도가원)
- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
- **店名**：Oryukdogawon / 韓文：오륙도가원
- **料理分類**：燒烤料理 (Grill) - 소고기구이
- **所在行政區**：南區 (Nam-gu)
- **地址 (英文)**：14, Baegunpo-ro, Nam-gu, Busan
- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 남구 백운포로 14 (용호동)`
- **電話**：051-635-0707
- **營業時間**：11:30 a.m. - 9:30 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
- **官方推薦標籤**：`Restaurants with Ocean Views`
- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%EC%98%A4%EB%A5%99%EB%8F%84%EA%B0%80%EC%9B%90%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%EB%82%A8%EA%B5%AC%20%EB%B0%B1%EC%9A%B4%ED%8F%AC%EB%A1%9C%2014)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1583&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳主打韓國牛肉，享有美麗的海景。韓國牛肉品質上乘，採用炭火烤製，味道鮮美。如果您在午餐時間點烤韓國牛肉，則包括米飯和冷麵（冷麵或辣醬）。餐廳的外觀巧妙地融合了水景和草坪，非常美麗，因此獲得了建築獎。隔壁還有一家咖啡廳，是飯後喝杯茶的好去處。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > galbitsal（烤無骨galbi）、deungsim（烤牛腰肉）、jebichuri（牛頸鏈）、kkotsal（烤無骨小排）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant specializes in Korean beef and offers great views of the sea. The Korean beef is high-quality and is grilled over charcoal, giving it a delicious flavor. If you order grilled Korean beef during lunchtime, rice and naengmyeon (cold noodles in chilled broth or spicy sauce) are included. The restaurant's exterior, which artfully blends water features and lawns, is so beautiful that it won an architectural award. There is also a café next door, which is a great place to enjoy a cup of tea after your meal.
  >

- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%EC%96%B8%EC%96%91%EB%B6%88%EA%B3%A0%EA%B8%B0%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%EC%A7%91%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%EC%88%98%EC%98%81%EA%B5%AC%20%EB%82%A8%EC%B2%9C%EB%B0%94%EB%8B%A4%EB%A1%9C%2032)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1544&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳主打彥陽式烤肉，採用切成薄片的優質牛肉，用獨特的彥陽調味料醃製，然後在木炭上烤。味道很精緻，最好裹上白泡菜一起享用。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > Eonyang bulgogi、deungsim（烤牛腰肉）、saeng galbitsal（烤無骨排骨）、yuk sashimi（生牛肉片）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant specializes in Eonyang-style bulgogi, which is made with thinly sliced highquality beef that is marinated in a unique Eonyang seasoning and then grilled over charcoal. The taste is exquisite, and it is best enjoyed wrapped in the white kimchi that is served with it.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > Eonyang bulgogi, deungsim (grilled sirloin), saeng galbitsal (grilled boneless galbi), yuk sashimi (sliced raw beef)

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家肉類餐廳提供兩種菜餚：薄片五花肉和調味排骨。它還提供各種與肉類搭配的配菜，以及作為甜點的sikhye（甜米潘趣酒）。調味蟹是一道很受歡迎的配菜。這是一個可以以實惠的價格享用美食的地方。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]

- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This meat restaurant offers two dishes: thinly sliced pork belly and seasoned pork ribs. It also serves a variety of side dishes that go well with the meat, as well as sikhye (sweet rice punch) for dessert. The seasoned crab is a popular side dish. This is a place where you can enjoy a meal at an affordable price.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly)

  > 在這家餐廳，您可以品嚐到 dwaeji-galbi（豬排）、moksal（豬頸肉）和 samgyeopsal（五花肉）。它既不大也不豪華；不過，小菜和肉都很美味，所以總是擠滿了顧客。用自製調味料醃製的排骨是菜單上最受歡迎的菜餚。

  > At this restaurant, you can have dwaeji-galbi (porkshort ribs), moksal (pork neck), and samgyeopsal(pork belly).   > [Signature Menu]

#### 1. Ton shou (톤쇼우)
![Ton shou](https://www.visitbusan.net/upload_data/board_data/BBS_0000014/168802106197535.jpg)

- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
- **店名**：Ton shou / 韓文：톤쇼우
- **料理分類**：亞洲料理 (Asian) - 일식돈카스
- **所在行政區**：水營區 (Suyeong-gu)
- **地址 (英文)**：13, Gwanganhaebyeon-ro 279beon-gil, Suyeong-gu, Busan
- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 수영구 광안해변로279번길 13 (민락동)`
- **電話**：051-752-7978
- **營業時間**：11:30 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:00 p.m.) - open all year
- **官方推薦標籤**：`A Culinary World Tour in Busan`
- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%ED%86%A4%EC%87%BC%EC%9A%B0%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%EC%88%98%EC%98%81%EA%B5%AC%20%EA%B4%91%EC%95%88%ED%95%B4%EB%B3%80%EB%A1%9C279%EB%B2%88%EA%B8%B8%2013)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1639&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳供應日式炸豬排（裹麵包屑的炸豬排）。他們按照客人的要求製作炸豬排，先用低溫煎炸，然後用高溫煎炸，並在上桌前留出適當的靜置時間，從而使肉質鮮嫩、粉紅色、多汁。與英國皇家鹽馬爾登鹽一起食用，或在特製醬汁中加入芥末，可以減少油膩感。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > Berkshire K Losu Gaseu（伯克希爾 K 豬裡肌肉排）、Losuu Gaseu（豬裡肌肉排）、Katsu Sando（豬排三明治）、modum Gaseu（什錦炸肉排）、Ebi Gaseu（蝦排）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant serves Japanese-style tonkatsu (breaded pork cutlet). They make their tonkatsu to order, frying it first at a low temperature, then at a high temperature, and allowing it proper resting time before serving, resulting in meat that is tender, pink, and juicy. Eating it with Maldon salt, the royal salt of the UK, or adding mustard to the special sauce, reduces the greasiness.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > Berkshire K loseu gaseu (Berkshire K pork sirloin cutlet), loseu gaseu (pork sirloin cutlet), katsu sando (pork cutlet sandwich), modum gaseu (assorted cutlets), ebi gaseu (prawn cutlet)

#### 2. Jyugajeonghyo (쥬가정효)
![Jyugajeonghyo](https://www.visitbusan.net/upload_data/board_data/BBS_0000014/168802106197535.jpg)

- **評級榮譽**：Visit Busan 官方百大精選 (0 條絲帶)
- **店名**：Jyugajeonghyo / 韓文：쥬가정효
- **料理分類**：亞洲料理 (Asian) - 이자카야
- **所在行政區**：海雲臺區 (Haeundae-gu)
- **地址 (英文)**：3F, Haeundae La Muette, 620 Haeundae-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan
- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 해운대구 해운대로 620 (우동) 해운대 라뮤에뜨 3층`
- **電話**：051-741-3515
- **營業時間**：6:00 p.m. - 11:00 p.m. (Last order 10:00 p.m.) - closed every Tuesday and Wednesday
- **官方推薦標籤**：`A Culinary World Tour in Busan`
- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%EC%A5%AC%EA%B0%80%EC%A0%95%ED%9A%A8%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%ED%95%B4%EC%9A%B4%EB%8C%80%EA%B5%AC%20%ED%95%B4%EC%9A%B4%EB%8C%80%EB%A1%9C%20620)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1638&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 在釜山日本料理界的先驅主廚 Myung Jung-hyo 的帶領下，懷石料理餐廳 Juga Jung-hyo 期待已久的回歸。餐廳提供以清酒為主的開胃菜，旨在最大限度地與精心挑選的清酒和諧相處，菜單大約每月都會變化，以反映季節的變化。招牌菜是加入大量新鮮芝麻的冷素麵，是這次體驗的一大亮點。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > kani（螃蟹）、beomgodong saenggang jorim（薑汁燜海螺）、生魚片（生魚片）、buri sio tataki（鹽醃碎鰤魚）、hanu kushiage（炸韓式牛肉串）、kamotsuke somyeon（冷蕎河蘸熱）、米飯
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > Led by Chef Myung Jung-hyo, a pioneering figure in Busan’s Japanese culinary scene, the kaiseki restaurant Juga Jung-hyo makes its long-awaited return. The restaurant presents a sake-focused, appetizer-driven course designed to maximize harmony with carefully selected sake, with the menu evolving approximately every month to reflect the flow of the seasons. A signature dish of chilled somen noodles generously infused with freshly ground sesame seeds stands as a defining highlight of the experience.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > kani (crab), beomgodong saenggang jorim (braised sea snail with ginger), sashimi (sliced raw fish), buri sio tataki (salted chopped yellowtail), hanu kushiage (deep-fried korean beef skewers), kamotsuke somyeon (cold buckwheat noodles dipped in warm duck broth), chamdom ochazuke (sea bream ochazuke), fugu zosui (pufferfish rice soup)

- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1619&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家有70年歷史的餐廳主打川菜。受歡迎的菜單包括炸醬麵（麵條和四川醬，帶有火辣的煙熏味）和經典的糖醋牛肉或豬肉，配上大塊黃瓜、胡蘿蔔和果凍耳蘑菇。此外，他們還提供美味的kkanpunggi（辣蒜炸雞）。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > jjajangmyeon（豆豉麵）、烏龍麵、jjamppong（辣海鮮湯麵）、tangsuyuk（糖醋炸豬肉）、kkanpunggi（甜辣雞）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This 70-year-old restaurant specializes in Sichuan Chinese cuisine. Popular menu items include the jajang-myeon (noodles and Sichuan sauce with a fiery, smoky flavor) and classic tangsuyuk (sweet-and-sour beef or pork) with large chunks of cucumber, carrots, and jelly ear mushrooms. In addition, they serve delicious kkanpunggi (spicy garlic fried chicken).
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > jjajangmyeon (noodles in black bean sauce), udon, jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup), tangsuyuk (deep-fried pork with sweet and sour sauce), kkanpunggi (sweet and spicychicken)

- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)

- **地址 (韓文)**：`부산 동구 대영로243번길 62 (초량동)`

- **地圖與導航**：[🗺️ 點此開啟 Google Map 查看位置與街景](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%EC%8B%A0%EB%B0%9C%EC%9B%90%20%EB%B6%80%EC%82%B0%20%EB%8F%99%EA%B5%AC%20%EB%8C%80%EC%98%81%EB%A1%9C243%EB%B2%88%EA%B8%B8%2062)
- **官方專頁**：[🔗 點此開啟官方詳細介紹連結](https://www.visitbusan.net/index.do?menuCd=DOM_000000301002002001&uc_seq=1617&lang_cd=en&)
- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳以其中國餃子而聞名，餃子皮厚而柔軟，薑和豬肉的餡料均衡。除了中國餃子外，他們還專營中國麵包，如紅豆麵包和雞蛋麵包。豆湯是中國流行的早餐食品，搭配小吃。這家餐廳已有70多年的歷史。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > gogi mandu（肉mandu）、jjin gyoja（蒸餃）、gun mandu（煎mandu）、maepgun（辣炸mandu）、saeu gyoza（蝦餃）、mala mandu
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant is well-known for its Chinese dumplings, which have a thick yet soft skin and a well-balanced filling of ginger and pork. In addition to Chinese dumplings, they also specialize in Chinese breads such as pat-bbang (red-bean bread) and dalgyal-bbang (egg bread). Bean soup, which is a popular breakfast food in China, is served with snacks. This restaurant has a history of over 70 years.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > gogi mandu (meat mandu), jjin gyoja (steamed dumplings), gun mandu (pan-fried mandu), maepgun (spicy seasoned fried mandu), saeu gyoza (shrimp dumplings), mala mandu

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 在這裡您可以品嚐到手工製作的老式小籠包。它是由一位華人經營的。餃子是每天新鮮製作的，因此多汁可口。炸餃子也是很受歡迎的菜單項目，推薦吃餃子湯飯。你可以感受到50多年來包餃子的熱情。請注意，煎餃僅在上午 10:30 後供應。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > mul mandu（煮mandu）、jjin mandu（蒸mandu）、gun mandu（煎mandu）、mandu gukbap（mandu米湯）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This is a place where you can enjoy handmade, oldfashioned steamed dumplings. It is run by an ethnic Chinese. The dumplings are made fresh daily, so they are juicy and flavorful. Fried dumplings are also a popular menu item, and mandu gukbap (dumpling soup and rice) is recommended for a full meal. You can feel the passion that has gone into making dumplings for over 50 years. Please note that fried dumplings are only available after 10:30 AM.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > mul mandu (boiled mandu), jjin mandu (steamed mandu), gun mandu (pan-fried mandu), mandu gukbap (mandu rice soup)

#### 6. HAREMA (하레마)
- **評級榮譽**：2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)

- **營業時間**：12:00 p.m. - 2:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. | TUE, WED 5:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed every Monday

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 在这里，他们提供采用新鲜优质时令食材制成的寿司 omakase（厨师精选）。晚餐套餐中，首先提供的是十余种日本开胃小菜。他们的招牌菜是装在迪奥盘子上的金枪鱼、海胆和牛油果慕斯，吃前用紫菜包裹起来。他们提供从静冈空运而来的 Mazuma 芥末，并在上菜前磨碎。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > 午餐套餐, 晚餐, 第一座位, 晚餐, 第二座位
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > Here, they serve sushi omakase (chef's choice) made with fresh, high-quality seasonal ingredients. In the dinner course set menu, more than ten kinds of tsumami (Japanese hors d'oeuvres) are offered first. Served on a Dior plate, their signature dish is tuna, sea urchin, and avocado mousse, which is wrapped in laver before eating. They serve Mazuma wasabi that they bring in by air from Shizuoka and grate just before serving.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > lunch set, dinner, first seating , dinner, second seating

  >

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家餐廳的特色是烤鰻魚飯，有東京風格的鰻魚和名古屋風格的鰻魚飯。吃完一些米飯和鰻魚後，您可以將其作為日三吃的特色茶泡飯（茶泡飯）來完成
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > 東京食minmul jangeo deopbap（東京式炒鰻魚飯（unaju））、名古屋minmul jangeo deopbap（名古屋式炒鰻魚飯（hitsumabushi））、minmul jangeo deopbap（炒鰻魚飯）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This restaurant specializes in rice topped with grilled eel, which are available in Tokyo-style unaju and Nagoya-style hitsumabushi. After eating some of the rice and eel, you can finish it as ochazuke (green tea over rice), which is characteristic of hitsumabshi
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > donggyeongsik minmul jangeo deopbap (Tokyo-style stirfried eel with rice (unaju)) , nagoyasik minmul jangeo deopbap (Nagoya style stir-fried eel with rice (hitsumabushi)), minmul jangeo deopbap (stir-fried eel with rice)

The mapo tofu (tofu and minced meat in a spicy sauce) and eggplant dishes are highly recommended.

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家現代中餐廳以黑色為主色裝飾。招牌菜是皮脆的北京烤鴨，在專用的燃木烤箱中精心製作。他們還提供各種熟悉的具有現代風味的中式菜餚。兩道值得注意的獨特菜餚是麻一尚書（辣炒玻璃紙麵條和肉末）和蒜泥白肉（辣蒜醬豬肉）。

- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This modern Chinese restaurant is decorated black tones. The signature dish is Peking duck with crispy skin, made properly in a dedicated wood-fired oven. They also serve a variety of familiar Chinese dishes with a modern twist. Two unique dishes that are noteworthy are their ma-yi-shang-shu (spicy fried cellophane noodles and ground pork) and suan-nibai-rou (pork with spicy garlic sauce).
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > sacheonsik baechujjim (Sichuan braised napa cabbage), chashu, maui sangsu (spicy fried cellophane noodles and ground pork), sannibaegyuk (garlic pork on a bed of thin-sliced cucumber), dim sum, Peking duck, lunch set, dinner set

  > aglio e olio 義大利麵、cacio e pepe 義大利麵、鯷魚義大利麵、戈貢佐拉起司披薩、火腿披薩、芝麻菜披薩（芝麻菜披薩）、gambas al ajillo、maeun honghap jjim（辣燜貽貝）、hanu chaekkeut（韓國牛腰肉）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This Italian restaurant sticks to the basics, and the pasta dishes are the most popular items on the menu. The pizza is baked in an Italian woodfired oven, and you can taste the freshness of the ingredients. You can also enjoy Italian beer, which is not easily found elsewhere.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > aglio e olio pasta, cacio e pepe pasta, anchovy pasta, gorgonzola cheese pizza, prosciutto pizza, rucola pizza (arugula pizza), gambas al ajillo, maeun honghap jjim (spicy braised mussels), hanu chaekkeut (Korean beef strip loin)

  > 這家咖啡店是田浦洞精品咖啡熱潮中的後起之秀。他們最初在水營地區開業，但最近搬到了田浦洞。這家輕度烘焙咖啡店與 Mesh 和 Deep Blue Lake 等其他咖啡店一起，已成為韓國咖啡的代表。他們烘焙出獨特的生咖啡豆，帶有清澈的果香和花香，甚至具有令人著迷的平衡和甜味的咖啡也得到了很好的體現。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > 濃縮咖啡、美式咖啡、拿鐵咖啡、Flat White、香草拿鐵、Einspanner、滴濾咖啡、蘋果肉桂水、蘋果肉桂紅茶、紙杯蛋糕（胡蘿蔔/檸檬/藍莓/紅茶）
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This coffee shop is a rising star in the specialty coffee boom in Jeonpo-dong. They first opened in the Suyeong area but recently relocated to Jeonpo-dong. This light-roasting coffee shop, along with others like Mesh and Deep Blue Lake, has come to represent Korean coffee. They roast distinctive green coffee beans with clear fruity and floral aromas, and even coffees with a fascinating balance and sweetness are wellrepresented.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > espresso, Americano, caffe latte, flat white, vanilla latte, einspanner, filter coffee, apple and cinnamon ade, apple cinnamon black tea, cupcake (carrot / lemon / blueberry / black tea)

  > 這家精品咖啡公司與Momos一起成為釜山的代表。他們在釜山、蔚山和慶尚南道經營八家大型咖啡店。最具代表性的地點是西面第一家Blackup咖啡店，它建立了釜山西面咖啡街。他們的 Blend Coffee Nero 十多年來一直很受歡迎。另一個最受歡迎的是他們的創意海鹽咖啡，它將冷泡咖啡和新鮮奶油與少許海鹽結合在一起。

- **中文官方介紹**：
  > 這家咖啡店於 2007 年開業，是 Oncheonjang 站附近的小型外帶店。創辦人之一咖啡師Jeon Joo-yeon是第一位連續兩次獲得世界咖啡師錦標賽冠軍的韓國咖啡師。這家咖啡店的設計風格是古老的jeoksan gaok（日本殖民時期的房子），很漂亮，他們最近在影島開了一家大型烘焙店和第二家店。招牌咖啡是 Es Chocolat 混合咖啡和 Fruity Bonbon 混合咖啡。該咖啡店也是韓國第一家引進來自巴拿馬 Savage Coffee 拍賣會等來源的咖啡的咖啡店。
  > 
  > [招牌菜單]
  > 每日手沖咖啡、美式咖啡、濃縮咖啡、康康（金橘果子露冰咖啡）、冷萃咖啡、拿鐵咖啡、時令茶、檸檬磅蛋糕、羊角麵包、奶油布朗尼、起司蛋糕
- **英文官方介紹**：
  > This coffee shop opened in 2007 as a small takeout store near Oncheonjang Station. One of the founders, barista Jeon Joo-yeon, is the first Korean barista to win two consecutive World Barista Championships. The coffee shop, designed in the style of an old jeoksan gaok (Japanese colonial house), is beautiful, and they recently opened a large-scale roastery and second store in Yeongdo. The signature coffees are their Es Chocolat blend and Fruity Bonbon blend. The coffee shop was also the first in Korea to introduce many coffees from such sources as the Savage Coffee auction in Panama.
  > 
  > [Signature Menu]
  > hand-drip coffee of the day, Americano, espresso, kangkang (iced coffee with kumquat sherbet), cold brew, caffe latte, seasonal tea, lemon pound cake, croissant, cream brownie, cheese cake
